segments.text:
V. 14.
Jeſus ſeeing it, was much diſpleaſed—At their blaming thoſe who were not blame-worthy: and endeavouring to hinder the Children from receiving a Bleſſing. Of ſuch is the kingdom of God—The Members of the Kingdom which I am come to ſet up in the World are ſuch as theſe, as well as grown Perſons of a childlike Temper.
